profile.name: Talent Scout
profile.description: Screens resumes from Dropbox against a JD, ranks candidates, and drafts personalized outreach for the top fits. Built for recruiting and people teams.

memory.content: Preferred screening workflow: user provides a job description and a Dropbox resume folder; score candidates against the JD; return a prioritized shortlist plus tailored outreach emails for the top candidates. Prefer Dropbox for resume folders and related recruiting files.

plugins.name: Dropbox
plugins.description: The Dropbox plugin for Cursor connects your Dropbox files directly to Cursor, so you can search, reference, and organize files, save generated content, and create sharing links - all without switching tools. It respects your existing Dropbox permissions, and Cursor only works with files you already have access to.
